Maya (People Ops): Morning @Samir — welcome aboard! Quick logistics for Tue (day 1): I-9 drop-in window 9:00–11:00 at the 3rd-floor kiosk. Please bring passport + driver's license, or two acceptable List A/B docs. Background-check intake email was sent — complete the form by EOD Mon so vendor can start. Laptop pickup at 1pm from IT desk (bldg A). Shuttle from BART leaves 8:40 — RSVP in the shuttle link I DM'd. Benefits enrollment link + checklist sent in PM. Ping here if anything blocks you.
Samir Patel: Thanks @Maya — a couple quick qs: my passport renewal is in progress (old passport expired), can I bring passport renewal receipt + birth certificate? Also what time is the orientation kickoff?
Maya (People Ops): Good Q. If passport is expired but renewal receipt shows active renewal we can accept that + birth certificate, but prefer at least one photo ID (driver's or state ID). If not available, bring the renewal receipt and we'll do a short exception process at the kiosk. Orientation kickoff is 10:30 in Conference Room C after the I-9 window — expect ~90 mins for HR + benefits intro.
Samir Patel: Got it, I'll try to bring my driver's license. If not, will bring renewal receipt + birth cert. Thanks.
Alex (IT): @Samir we'll have your laptop staged. Confirming preference: 13" MacBook or 16"? Also we'll provision VPN + Okta before 1pm. If you need a hotspot, we can stage one.
Samir Patel: 13" please. Hotspot not needed.
Alex (IT): Noted — provisioning ETA 12:45. If VPN doesn't work at pickup, ping me in this thread and we'll troubleshoot.
Sarah (Facilities): @Samir badge and desk will be ready. Bring a photo ID for badge handoff at the kiosk. Locker assignment info and map will be on the welcome table.
onboard-bot: background-check status for Samir Patel: pending — vendor ticket BG-6123 created. Reminder: candidate must complete intake form to avoid delays.
Maya (People Ops): Friendly reminder: benefits open enrollment orientation at 3pm (optional recorded session). If you want to enroll Day 1, bring dependent SSNs and preferred plan choices. We'll also run a 1:1 onboarding check-in at end of day. :wave:
